title: The New Pope
paragraphs: “Alright, it’s my turn now!”
“Motoyasu, don’t move forward! Have you forgotten the plan?”
“Yes, for now, just leave it to us and watch quietly.”
“It’s a hassle, so taking them out is the best option. There’s no such thing as a decent person wearing those priest robes.”
Anyone from the Three Heroes Church has no right to live. Wiping them all out would be ideal.
“I get how you feel, but you know, even Ren and Itsuki aren’t holding back. We’re just moving ahead first because if we let Motoyasu go all out, he might bring down the whole castle.”
“It’s a hassle!”
“Yeah.”
Rival unleashed a light-attribute breath attack, driving away the demons. What a convenient breath ability.
“A purifying wind shall blow! Now then, Sakura, Kou, assist me!”
Yuki-chan led the chant for a group spell. Fiancée was helping as well. Éclair was guarding the Queen, clashing swords with approaching soldiers. The Queen herself was counterattacking with magic.
“This is kind of scary…”
Mole clung to Rival and Assistant, trembling. Still, as if summoning courage, she jabbed her small sword at approaching demons, soldiers, and Three Heroes Church members.
“That’s right. First, have the courage to face them. Just follow the techniques we taught you. Everyone will have your back.”

Ren gave Mole some advice. Father used his shield to block attacks aimed at Mole, keeping the coordination smooth. And more importantly, Ren’s bad habit of hyper-focusing on enemies was improving. A good trend.
“Eagle Piercing Shot V!”
Itsuki unleashed a skill, cutting through the enemies ahead.
“There’s no end to this fight if we stay here. Let’s move on quickly!”
“Agreed. We’re close to the throne room and the royal living quarters. We need to check the areas where our target is most likely to be!”
Following Itsuki’s lead, we advanced forward and finally reached the throne room.
However…
On the way there, Father turned his gaze toward the window.
“You couldn’t see it from below, but… doesn’t it look like there’s some kind of strange barrier?”
“Huh?”

Ren, Itsuki, and the others also looked outside the castle. It definitely feels like some strange magical reaction is intensifying. And it’s not just around the castle—it seems to be expanding over the castle town… No, I doubt it’s just my imagination.
“If we don’t resolve this quickly, things are going to get out of hand.”
Everyone nodded at Father’s words. And then, we arrived at the throne room.
Inside, we found… an unfamiliar, incredibly muscular priest-like man and the impostor standing in for Trash? Also, there was a red-and-black pig.
“So you’ve made it this far, you fake heroes and that treasonous vixen who dares to call herself queen!”
The impostor spat those words at us. A purple aura was rising from him. And unless my eyes deceive me, his skin was also turning purple—he looks downright sinister.
“Fake heroes, huh? You only call us that because it’s inconvenient for you, right?”
“Exactly. You’re just like the people of this country who tried to dispose of us because we got in the way of your ambitions.”
“A complete lack of growth… Should I say that? Well, I suppose a month isn’t enough time for real change.”
Father and the others each responded.
“More importantly, what did you do to the castle and the town? Doesn’t this seem a bit excessive?”
“Demons are flying in the sky, attacking people, the soldiers in the castle are in a bizarre state… What did you do?”
“The people in the castle town were acting strange, too. Maybe they’re using the brainwashing weapons that Motoyasu mentioned.”
“It’d be easier to just blow them away.”
“Motoyasu, let’s at least hear them out a little first.”
Oh! Father is giving permission. That makes me even more motivated. It’s a shame I can’t go in without question, though.
“Hmph… The answer is simple. In order to defeat you fake heroes, we have performed a ritual to summon the true Three Holy Heroes!”
The priest-like man… Is he the new Pope of the Three Heroes Church? He twisted his rugged face. Was that supposed to be a smile? Still, he made his declaration with arrogance.
“The heroes have already been summoned. You did all this for something meaningless?”
Exactly. The heroes have already been summoned. And yet they’re resorting to another summoning… I’m too dumbfounded to even speak.

If I recall correctly, the people of this world always turn to hero summoning whenever something happens. Well, as Éclair mentioned before, any hero who becomes a threat to the country is deemed a fake, and when that becomes inconvenient, they just summon new heroes. So I guess it makes sense in a way.
“Aultcray… If you truly are my husband, then obey my command.”
“Hmph. I know nothing of a woman who sides with the Shield!”
The impostor Trash spat at the Queen with rather impressive acting. But he is not the real one. I know that man’s love. No matter what kind of treatment he received, he always believed in his wife.
“I see… No, let’s end this farce here. I will not permit you to impersonate Aultcray. In the name of the Queen, I shall judge you.”
The Queen quietly smiled and began chanting a spell.
“Hmph. Do you really think you can?”
The impostor disguised as Trash grinned confidently. He must be assuming that the Queen wouldn’t dare attack him.
“Dryfa Icicle Needle!”
With a loud boom, massive ice spikes shot out in rapid succession from the Queen’s outstretched hand.
“Wha—”
“Even if you were the real one, had you committed such outrageous acts, I would still attack.”
“Indeed. In past cycles, she froze him or trapped him in an ice prison.”
“So she’d do it even if he were real…?”
“Is there love in that? They’re husband and wife, right?”
“Mother…”
The Queen is someone who acts when necessary. Rather, it’s probably because of love that she freezes him. Surely.
The impostor narrowly dodged the spell, while the new Pope pulled out a hidden copy of a holy weapon from behind him, deflecting the attack.
“That weapon!?”
The Queen, Fiancé, and Éclair all displayed looks of shock. Ah, how nostalgic. But is it really okay for them to rely on a weapon that even our past selves were able to defeat? More importantly…
“So that weapon still exists.”

It’s the same weapon the Pope always tried to use to kill us. For us now, we could deal with it easier than twisting a baby’s arm. However, for the Queen, Éclair, or Fiancé, it seems they would struggle against it.

“Hmph… This was something the previous Pope treasured. We recovered it from the church that you impostors burned down! The fact that this sacred weapon remains is the greatest proof that you are the impostors! After all, it repelled your evil attacks!”
“We only destroyed it on a large scale, so if its magical defenses were high, it makes sense that some things would remain.”

The magic we cast was only powerful enough to destroy buildings—something no normal human could withstand. Given its output, it’s not surprising that some things survived. They look so triumphant, but their reasoning is so shallow.
“By the way, I’ve been wondering… why is your skin purple?”
“Maybe because of the ritual, they ended up summoning something? Look, they’ve got all these obviously evil-looking parts on them.”

“Yes, no matter how you look at it, you are neither normal nor human. According to Melromarc’s strict laws, you fall under the category of traitors who have taken in the blood of the impure and evil.”
The Queen declared this, pointing her fan at the impostor Trash, the new Pope, and the red-and-black pig.
“Oink.”
The red-and-black pig let out a sigh, as if exasperated. Who the hell are you!?
